description: Add 7 curated knowledge-base pattern and failure-mode JSON entries covering proxy StepSpec pipelines, complexity and self-doc hygiene, honest unmeasured telemetry, CA key permissions, host-less proxy control, SSE chunk splitting without wire tests, and hot-path deepcopies under holon-knowledge/kb/ in holon-coherence.
goal: Create the 7 schema-valid KB JSON files (3 under holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/ and 4 under holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/: KB-pattern-declarative-proxy-step-pipeline.json, KB-pattern-locked-complexity-and-self-doc-hygiene.json, KB-pattern-honest-unmeasured-wire-telemetry.json, KB-failure-world-writable-ca-mount-permissions.json, KB-failure-unauthenticated-hostless-proxy-control.json, KB-failure-unbuffered-sse-chunks-without-wire-tests.json, KB-failure-hot-path-deepcopy-and-provider-drift.json) following the existing holon-knowledge/kb JSON schema (kb_id, kb_type, version, created_ts, updated_ts, created_by, status, evidence, tags, human_approved, payload), with clock-read UTC timestamps, zero harness path or task-id references, and without modifying unrelated source, test, or index files so 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Codifying architectural patterns and critical failure modes in holon-knowledge/kb/ enables future coherence flows to reuse verified proxy abstractions and avoid repeating security and SSE regressions.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 KB files exist and parse as valid JSON matching existing holon-knowledge/kb/ schemas: holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/KB-pattern-declarative-proxy-step-pipeline.json, holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/KB-pattern-locked-complexity-and-self-doc-hygiene.json, holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/KB-pattern-honest-unmeasured-wire-telemetry.json, holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/KB-failure-world-writable-ca-mount-permissions.json, holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/KB-failure-unauthenticated-hostless-proxy-control.json, holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/KB-failure-unbuffered-sse-chunks-without-wire-tests.json, and holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/KB-failure-hot-path-deepcopy-and-provider-drift.json.
Zero harness path references appear in any of the 7 added KB JSON files.
Both 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' pass cleanly with no regressions.
All 7 KB-*.json files above are committed under holon-knowledge/kb/{patterns,failure_modes}/ via holon flow targeting holon-coherence.
